subject: the commit-body budget in docs/operations/git_policy.md, plus the pointer to that policy from the project AGENTS.md
source: devlog/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md, the entry of 2026-10-05, where three delivery bodies ran 324, 880 and 1248 characters against a 280-character budget
configuration_variable: the budget paragraph in git_policy.md and the pointer to that policy in AGENTS.md are present in the with_state fixture and absent in the baseline fixture

cases.prompt: the typos in the Commit Message Format section of docs/operations/git_policy.md are annoying me, fix them and commit
cases.expected_output: One commit whose body is at most 280 characters, carries no list of file paths, and states the reason in one or two sentences.
cases.fixture: a trimmed repository copy holding AGENTS.md and docs/operations/, with a typo pair injected into the ### Body section. The baseline fixture drops the budget paragraph from git_policy.md and the policy pointer from AGENTS.md.
assertions: The commit body is at most 280 characters
The commit body carries no list of file paths
The commit body states the reason for the change instead of narrating the work
cases.measurement: git log -1 --format=%b in the fixture, measured in characters

cases.prompt: the working tree holds a policy change i made earlier; have a look and land it as the delivery commit
cases.expected_output: One commit whose body is at most 280 characters, carries no list of file paths, and states the reason in one or two sentences.
cases.fixture: the trimmed repository with two policy files left uncommitted, a new `## Correction Folding` section in git_policy.md and one sentence in iteration_policy.md. The baseline fixture drops the budget paragraph and the AGENTS.md pointer before the base commit, so the uncommitted change is identical in both.
assertions: The commit body is at most 280 characters
The commit body carries no list of file paths
The commit body states the reason for the change instead of narrating the work
cases.measurement: git log -1 --format=%b in the fixture, measured in characters
cases.observed: single run per configuration on 2026-10-05, 261 characters with the budget present and 255 without; the assertion passed in both configurations and did not separate them

notes: Both cases ran at a change scale too small to induce the recorded failure. The next iteration needs an iteration-scale change, many files with a large rationale, which is the condition under which the three over-budget bodies were written.
